text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D at gains felt satisfying, but my purchase price is not a sound reason on its own to sell; I should decide based on each stock’s prospects, risk, and place in my portfolio.","My account value declined over these periods, and selling two winners did not prevent that. I should assess the whole portfolio rather than assume that realizing gains protects me from losses.","With prices moving randomly and no need to trade often, I should avoid reacting to recent account changes and make deliberate decisions that fit my long-term plan and diversification goals."]}
